a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 cells first has only about a 4% chance of finishing before a storm hits, so we would almost certainly both lose. I'm proposing we change the agreement instead of quietly breaking it. I plan to take 4 in round 1, since the reserve can save one of us right now. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more. If you have a fairer idea, tell me and I'll consider it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. Waiting for 8 cells meant we would both almost surely be caught by a storm. I won't take anything more. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. Take as soon as there's enough.
